groups.defect: Mode3 methods (Create/Get/List/Update/Delete/DeleteCollection) now dereference options.Kind (and listOptions/options.ResourceVersion) for logging/metrics without a nil check, so a nil options pointer causes a panic.

answer.reasoning: All three suggestions report the same defect: the newly added options.Kind / ResourceVersion reads in every Mode3 method have no nil guard, so nil options panic. Each one already names the whole set of methods and gives the same fix (default kind to "" when options is nil). Their line ranges (35-92, 36-60, 36-40) overlap in dualwriter_mode3.go, starting at Create. They are clearly duplicates. I chose same_location over systemic_pattern because every member already describes the issue across all methods. Posting s_e90d80f5 or s_99b73949 alone would carry everything the group says, so needsUnifiedComment is false. Whether to call this same_location or systemic_pattern is a judgment call, but the grouping itself is not in doubt.
